features: Motion Detection 2.0: human and vehicle classification, enabled by default on all analog channels
Smart events: line crossing and intrusion detection
Audio via coaxial cable on 8 channels
notes: Datasheet (DT81DX) gives 4 IP channels (up to 12) as standard and 8 IP channels (up to 16) with Enhanced IP mode on, each up to 4 Mbps. The product page (DT81DW) gives 8 analog + 4 IP channels.
Datasheet gives up to 10 TB per HDD; the product page gives up to 8 TB. HDD capacity left out.
Datasheet lists RS-485 support; the product page lists no RS-485 port.
